$description: What each hue writes on the elements a component marks with it: the channels --arena-hue-ink, --arena-hue-edge, --arena-hue-fill-strong, --arena-hue-fill-soft and --arena-hue-on-ink, as the expression each takes. on-ink is the content set on a mark filled with the hue's ink; identity-N writes it as initial, so a solid mark on a categorical colour falls back to the neutral content. A status hue reads its own roles (--hue-<hue>-*, answered by the style plugin) and its own wash level (--level-hue-soft-<hue>); identity-N stands for the eight categorical colours, N read as 1 to 8. It is a table rather than a CSS rule because a hue is a name a manifest gives a value, and the hue sheet writes it as one rule per slot and value so that the element reading a channel is always the element given it: a CSS rule selecting by ancestor would let a nested component read the colour of the one around it. A value mapped to no hue writes every channel as initial.
